punchline: The limit was 35 percent; 46 in December, 57 in February: the overshoot came back larger.
thirty_sec: In 1990-91 Salomon Brothers exceeded the 35 percent Treasury auction cap using unauthorized customer bids; in August 1991 Gutfreund and Strauss resigned and the board was to consider vice chairman Meriwether's position.
